2115555466873033010.en_summary: $GOOGL CFO: Alphabet has accumulated $924B in future purchase commitments and $152B in pre-commencement leases and other obligations at end of Q3. Amounts reflect maximum contractual obligations with variable pricing and volume flexibility that could result in lower spend.
2115555466873033010.zh_summary: $GOOGL 首席財務官：Alphabet 在第三季末累積了 9240 億美元的未來採購承諾及 1520 億美元的預開工租約和其他義務。金額反映最高合約義務，部分協議具有可變定價和數量靈活性，可能導致支出較低。
